## Problem

Who is affected, and what task is difficult?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the desired outcome rather than only a technology choice.

## Alternatives

What other approaches have been considered?

## Security and platform impact

Consider permissions, credential use, result data, accessibility and Windows/Linux/macOS differences.

State whether the proposal fits the personal, single-machine open-source scope. Team identity, centralized policy, managed nodes and multi-party workflows belong to the separately planned enterprise product unless the proposal explains a local-user need.

## Acceptance criteria

How would a contributor or reviewer verify that the proposal is complete?

Include reader-facing documentation, synthetic test data, failure/cleanup behavior and the platforms that must be checked.
